subtitle: Penang's original hotel strip, now defending its sand with 62 buried sand-filled containers while a funded permanent fix sits unbuilt.
spike_statement: In July 2026 Penang buried 62 sand-filled containers, stacked five meters high, along 44 meters of shoreline fronting the hotel that opened this coast in 1948.

levers.photo_tone: Flat grey-brown Strait of Malacca water against tan sand and hotel greenery, the buried erosion-barrier construction zone marking the most eroded 44 meters in front of Lone Pine Hotel during the Jul-Aug 2026 works
